catalogue.name: The Nanite Resurrection
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Summon Disassembler Swarm
sharedRules.description: Summon(D3 wounds of Disassembler Swarm within 6” with full action)

sharedRules.name: Resurrection Globe
sharedRules.description: Restore one (1) wound to a friendly unit within 12” that has the Defence(re-roll) trait (deploy any returned models in cohesion) in the endphase.

sharedRules.name: Nightmare Portal
sharedRules.description: Deploy one (1) unit from staging within 6” of this model (without action markers), one use.

sharedRules.name: Power of the Elements Mystic(3x2)
sharedRules.description:
When activated, may roll level number of dice and pick one (1) available power from school mystic list. If you get several dice at target level, you may use boosted version. Also apply all results of ‘1’.

Example: Player A rolls ‘1’,’1’,’5’ and may select a 5+ or worse power from the applicable school. Player A also applies the boosted version of the ‘1’ result.

sharedRules.name: Aerial Interdiction
sharedRules.description: 36” from this model is hazardous terrain for enemy aircraft/VTOL.

sharedRules.name: AA Shroud
sharedRules.description: Bestow Target(pothots) vs Aircraft and VTOL (15”). The spotter trait may not be used vs friendly units within 15”.

sharedRules.name: Q-shields
sharedRules.description: Model has 1 additional Wound at Defence(8). This does not count towards unit size.

sharedRules.name: Mindeless
sharedRules.description: Unit is Fanatic.

sharedRules.name: Greater Awareness
sharedRules.description: Unit ignores the No Rush and Unbending faction traits.

sharedRules.name: No Rush
sharedRules.description: Units in this faction may not take the triple move action.

sharedRules.name: Unbending
sharedRules.description: Units in this faction have Cover(max 1).

sharedRules.name: Flesh Rags
sharedRules.description: Unit has Repel(2).

sharedRules.name: Golden Skin
sharedRules.description: Unit has Loathing.

sharedRules.name: Rusted
sharedRules.description: Unit has Defence(-1).

sharedRules.name: IFF Protocols
sharedRules.description: Attacks versus enemy units within 2” of this unit are inaccurate instead of potshots from the intermingled rule.

sharedRules.name: The Futility of Resistance
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Assuming direct control: remove all remaining action markers from one (1) unit in the endphase.
● The Rebel Metal: 1 enemy single wound ground vehicle rolls on the damage table with -3.
● Back to Dust: return any one (1) friendly unit to staging.

sharedRules.name: Bestow Restore(1) (9", 1 regular unit only)
sharedRules.description: One regular unit within 9" gains ability Restore(1): Unit regains 1 of wounds in the endphase, beginning with models that have lost wounds and then returning lost models (in cohesion).

sharedRules.name: Bestow Robust(1) (9", closest)
sharedRules.description: Closest vehicle witin 9" gains ability Robust(1): Rolls on the damage table for this vehicle are reduced by 1.

sharedRules.name: Bestow Charge(2") (9")
sharedRules.description: All models in units within 9" gains ability. CC attacks have +2" distance range.

sharedRules.name: Plasma-parasite
sharedRules.description: Unit has wound(re-roll), one use.

sharedRules.name: Asset uplink
sharedRules.description: Model has Spotter.

sharedRules.name: Inflict Defence(-1) (2”, vehicles only, no stacking)
sharedRules.description: Models of enemy vehicles within 2" has Defence(-1), this effeckt does not stack.

sharedRules.name: Bestow Medical Support (trooper, 12")

sharedRules.name: Bestow Restore(1) (12", troopers)
sharedRules.description: Trooper units within 12" gains ability Restore(1): Unit regains 1 of wounds in the endphase, beginning with models that have lost wounds and then returning lost models (in cohesion).

sharedRules.name: Bestow Medical Support (swarms, 12")

sharedRules.name: Bestow Restore(1) (swarms, 12")
sharedRules.description: Swarm units within 12" gains ability Restore(1): Unit regains 1 of wounds in the endphase, beginning with models that have lost wounds and then returning lost models (in cohesion).

sharedRules.name: Inflict Defence(-1) (12”, vehicle/massive)
sharedRules.description: Models of enemy vehicle and massive units within 12" has Defence(-1).

sharedRules.description: Until this unit attacks or is attacked, you can use any miniature(s) to represent it.
